_comment: Public 'Fixes & work in progress' page (/fixes/), built by scripts/build.py. One entry per error class in tests/corpus/ERROR_CLASSES.md (or a named piece of work). Status rules, checked at build: 'fixed' only with a live check on pdfree.io (verified = date + what was run); 'released' = merged and live, the check on pdfree.io not done yet; 'partly' = some causes fixed and checked live, others open; at most two 'in_progress'. No competitor names, no user documents, no document IDs.

items.title: Compress to a target size, without making text unreadable
items.summary: Today the 5 / 10 / 25 MB choices apply fixed settings and don't check the result. We measured it: the target was met for 13–50 % of large files. We are building a size check that keeps small print, stamps and Chinese text readable, and says so honestly when a size can't be reached.

items.verified: 2026-11-06, qpdf recovery e2e on pdfree.io (800 mixed passwords, forced failures, the Unlock screen), 9/9
items.title: After one failure, password-protected PDFs stopped opening until the page was reloaded
items.summary: If decrypting one file failed (for example a very large one), every later protected or restricted PDF in the same tab failed too, and Unlock called a right password wrong. Now the next file works, and 'incorrect password' is shown only when the password is wrong.

items.title: Compress turned transparency masks into colour images
items.summary: Images with soft edges or transparency could get a slightly wrong outline. Masks now stay as they are.

items.verified: 2026-11-05, a real affected document through pdfree.io
items.title: Compress merged images that only looked alike
items.summary: Two images with the same pixels but a different mask or size could be stored as one, so one of them was drawn wrong. Only true duplicates are merged now.

items.title: Print-ready (CMYK) images: smaller without any change
items.summary: Standard and Maximum now re-pack CMYK images losslessly: the same colours, fewer bytes on large print files.

items.title: Digitally signed PDFs lost their valid signature without warning
items.summary: Any edit breaks a digital signature. PDFree now tells you before a tool makes a copy of a signed PDF; the original keeps its signature.

items.title: Compress could return a file larger than the original
items.summary: If compressing doesn't make the file smaller, you now get your original file back.

items.title: Hidden metadata on images kept large files large
items.summary: Editing history stored on each image (often megabytes) is now removed on Standard and Maximum.

items.title: Clean Scan kept dark backgrounds
items.summary: Light text on a dark background can now be turned into dark text on white (an option, off by default, shown in the preview).

items.verified: 2026-10-30, model files and output on pdfree.io
items.title: Chinese and Japanese scans were read poorly
items.summary: A second, stronger reader is used for Chinese and Japanese scans on desktop computers.

items.title: Contrast enhancement blurred Chinese and Japanese characters
items.summary: Chinese and Japanese scans skip the contrast step that made thin strokes run together.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, code check: pdfree.io serves the same ocrEngine.js / ocrUI.js / ppocrEngine.js as the main build (the behaviour was measured before merge)

items.title: Traditional Chinese scans were read as simplified Chinese
items.summary: Traditional Chinese is now recognised with its own model.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, OCR of a traditional Chinese scan on pdfree.io (small-device path): traditional forms 136, simplified 2; forced simplified model 0 / 120

items.title: A line repeated on every page disappeared from the Word body
items.summary: Only lines at the page edges are moved to the header; a repeated line in the middle of the page stays in the text.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, PDF to Word on its documents: pdfree.io = the main build

items.title: Word's symbol bullets came out as boxes
items.summary: Bullets made with Symbol or Wingdings fonts are real list items in the Word file.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, PDF to Word on its documents: pdfree.io = the main build

items.title: Numbered section headings came out as body text
items.summary: Numbered headings only a little larger than the text are recognised as headings.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, PDF to Word on its documents: pdfree.io = the main build

items.title: Short stacked lines were merged into one paragraph
items.summary: Lines stacked without a gap (addresses, lists) keep their own paragraphs.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, PDF to Word on its documents: pdfree.io = the main build

items.title: Spaced-out Chinese and Japanese text had a space between every character
items.summary: Letter-spaced CJK text is read as words.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, PDF to Word on its documents: pdfree.io = the main build

items.title: Bold text drawn twice came out two to four times
items.summary: Text drawn over itself to look bold is read once.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, PDF to Word on its documents: pdfree.io = the main build

items.title: Chinese text in some fonts was missing
items.summary: Fonts that name their characters through Adobe's CJK tables are read and shown.

items.title: Urdu words ran together
items.summary: Urdu Nastaleeq text keeps the spaces between words.
items.verified: 2026-11-05, PDF to Word on its documents: pdfree.io = the main build

items.title: Arabic letters joined in one glyph came out reversed
items.summary: A glyph that stands for several letters keeps them in the right order.

items.title: Two-letter Arabic ligatures came out with letters swapped
items.summary: Fixed for Arabic. Some Urdu and Persian swaps remain.

items.title: Words glued together in tightly set lines
items.summary: Words a space or 0.15 em apart are separated, in text and in table cells. Some very tight lines remain.

items.title: Right-to-left lines lost their word spaces
items.summary: Arabic and Hebrew lines stored in reading order keep the spaces between words.

items.title: One-column Arabic pages were split into two columns
items.summary: Justified right-to-left pages are no longer cut in the middle.

items.title: Columns were read across each other
items.summary: Newsletters with narrow gaps between columns are read column by column. Two-page spreads remain.

items.title: A table of contents came out as one paragraph
items.summary: Most contents entries get their own paragraph; some layouts remain.

items.title: Some PDFs gave other digits than the page shows
items.summary: Digits are taken as the page draws them for the most common font type; other cases remain.

items.title: Numbers in right-to-left lines were lost or split
items.summary: Numbers with spaces inside them are joined; other cases remain.

items.title: Language detection took most of a short scan's time
items.summary: When a page already has some text, its script is used and fewer checks run. Detection on pure scans is still slow.

items.title: Rotated pages lost their text in Word
items.summary: Pages turned with a rotation setting keep their text in the Word file.
